icd10_description: Crohn's disease of small intestine without complications
denial_reason: Step Therapy Requirement Not Met: Plan requires trial and clinical failure of two preferred biosimilars or generic immunosuppressives (azathioprine / methotrexate) prior to authorization of brand biologic.

clinical_facts.contraindication_documented: Patient suffered severe drug-induced hepatotoxicity (ALT > 350 U/L) on azathioprine in 2024 and developed intractable pancytopenia on methotrexate. Generic step therapy is medically contraindicated.
clinical_facts.disease_severity: Endoscopic simple endoscopic score for Crohn's disease (SES-CD) = 14 (severe ulceration, terminal ileum). Withholding biologic therapy risks bowel perforation and emergency resection.
